open_decisions.question: RPTPOS00 reads POSITION-MASTER (no FD; COPY POSREC in the FILE SECTION) and moves POS-DESCRIPTION, POS-CURRENT-VALUE and POS-PREVIOUS-VALUE into the report, but these names, END-OF-POSITIONS and WS-ERROR-MESSAGE are declared nowhere. What are the position fields (names, PIC, sign, decimals) that feed WS-POS-DESCRIPTION, WS-POS-VALUE and WS-POS-CHANGE-PCT?

Fifteen elementary level-01 items (e.g. HISTLD00 WS-COMMIT-THRESHOLD, the REPORT-RECORD print lines, DB2CONN WS-CONNECTION-STATE/WS-RETRY-COUNT/WS-MAX-RETRIES, DB2CMT WS-SAVEPOINT-ID) are catalogued as record-level items without Field IDs, so no Java type could be assigned. Should the reverse harness register Field IDs for them, or may later stages map them at record level using the catalogued PIC?

RPTPOS00 opens TRANSACTION-HISTORY but never reads it; the transaction, totals, exception and metrics paragraphs (2210, 2220, 2310, 2320, 2330) are missing. What transaction activity, totals and exception lines must the daily position report contain?

DD TRANHIST is declared as TRANSACTION-HISTORY in HISTLD00 (RECORD KEY TH-KEY, copybook HISTREC) and in RPTPOS00 (RECORD KEY TRAN-KEY, copybook TRNREC). Do both programs address the same indexed dataset, and which key/record layout is authoritative?

The character encoding of DISPLAY data is not stated anywhere (source declares IBM-ZOS only). Is EBCDIC code page 037 correct for all files and the DB2 subsystem, or another code page (e.g. 1140 with the euro sign, which changes the '$' currency byte in WS-POS-VALUE)?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

Several data names are declared more than once: CK-FILE-STATUS (CKPRST group line 35 and child line 38); ERR-VALIDATION/ERR-PROCESSING/ERR-SECURITY (RETHND level-88 and STD-ERROR-CODES fields); RC-SUCCESS..RC-CRITICAL, TRN-TYPE-BUY/SELL/FEE, ERROR-CODE and ERROR-ROUTINE across COMMON, RETHND and TRNREC. What Java naming convention should disambiguate them (for example record-qualified class members keyed by Field ID)?

RPTPOS00 performs 5 paragraphs that are not in the source (2210-READ-TRANSACTIONS, 2220-SUMMARIZE-ACTIVITY, 2310-WRITE-TOTALS, 2320-WRITE-EXCEPTIONS, 2330-WRITE-METRICS). Can the complete source be supplied, or must the business specify the transaction-activity, totals, exceptions and metrics sections of the daily position report?

BR-034 states: for each position the report computes change % = (POS-CURRENT-VALUE - POS-PREVIOUS-VALUE) / POS-PREVIOUS-VALUE x 100 and writes it on the detail line; a previous value of zero is not guarded. POS-CURRENT-VALUE, POS-PREVIOUS-VALUE, POS-DESCRIPTION, END-OF-POSITIONS and WS-ERROR-MESSAGE are declared nowhere. Confirm, correct or reject the formula; specify the source and type of the current and previous values and the required result when the previous value is zero.

Copybooks POSREC and TRNREC declare position status POS-STATUS ('A' active, 'C' closed, 'P' pending; BR-150) and transaction status TRN-STATUS ('P' pending, 'D' done, 'F' failed, 'R' reversed; BR-151); RPTPOS00 neither sets nor tests them. Should the daily position report filter or flag positions or transactions by these statuses?
